messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Adam,

We act for Arkwright Quantum on the proposed QX-Clock licence to your client Caldera Defence. Please find attached a mutual NDA for signature so we can begin sharing the technical and diligence materials. Grateful for any comments, though we hope it is uncontroversial.

Kind regards,
Elena
